findings.message: cli/tasks.ts still declares its own TASKS_DIR = ".codictator/tasks" while features/workflow/task-store.ts now owns and exports the same constant; import TASKS_DIR from features/workflow/index.ts so the directory has one owner (SPEC §1.4 one fact, one owner).
readBranchAt treats timedOut as undefined (the stated behaviour change for task-summary and cli branchOf) but the test covers only empty, nonzero-code and truncated reads; add a timedOut: true case.
